en_title: GTA 6 Fans Think Rockstar Games Is Shooting an Elaborate and Expensive Live-Action Trailer in Miami
subtitle: 现实版罪恶都市
opus_summary: 玩家发现迈阿密街头有摄影团队拍摄《GTA6》主题改装车队，猜测Rockstar正在制作真人预告片。官方尚未回应，该作将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。

paragraphs.en: Eagle-eyed Rockstar fans have noticed camera crews recording convoys of flashy GTA 6 -themed cars in Miami, creating speculation over a new live-action trailer.
paragraphs.cn: 眼尖的Rockstar粉丝发现，有摄影团队正在迈阿密拍摄由炫酷的《GTA6》主题车辆组成的车队，因而猜测官方正在制作新的真人预告片。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games has been conquering the city of Miami over the last few weeks as it ramps up to the release of GTA 6, which is set in a fictional version of Miami called Vice City. As a result, Rockstar has plastered all kinds of ads around the area, sent in a Vice City blimp to fly over Florida, and announced unique celebrations like a Vice City-themed NBA game with the Miami Heat in November. It's an unprecedented marketing campaign that has quite literally turned the city into a real-life version of GTA's universe.
paragraphs.cn: 过去几周，为了给《GTA6》发售造势，Rockstar的宣传攻势席卷了迈阿密。这款游戏的故事发生在以迈阿密为原型的虚构城市「罪恶都市」。Rockstar在当地铺设了各式广告，让一艘罪恶都市主题飞艇飞越佛罗里达州，还宣布了别具一格的庆祝活动，包括11月与迈阿密热火队合作举办的罪恶都市主题NBA比赛。这场前所未有的营销活动，确实把这座城市变成了现实版的《GTA》世界。

paragraphs.en: With that said, there appear to be a variety of things happening right under Miamians' noses without much explanation. Fans have started noticing exotic sports cars driving around the city in convoys, sometimes joined by a camera crew. These aren't just ordinary cars, as they're modified to resemble ones from the GTA series. In some videos and photos posted by fans, you can see in-universe car brands such as Grotti (a parody of Ferrari) and Emerus (a parody of McLaren) on some of the vehicles that are zooming around.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，迈阿密市民眼皮底下似乎还在发生各种尚未得到多少解释的事情。粉丝开始注意到，异国豪华跑车组成的车队在城中穿行，有时还有摄影团队随行。这些并非普通车辆，而是经过改装，模仿了《GTA》系列中的汽车。在粉丝发布的一些视频和照片中，可以看到部分疾驰的车辆上带有游戏世界中的汽车品牌标识，例如恶搞法拉利的Grotti，以及恶搞迈凯伦的Emerus。

paragraphs.en: Filming of a separate video or trailer for GTA VI continues in Miami🌴
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》的另一支视频或预告片仍在迈阿密拍摄中🌴

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games and West Coast Customs popped out in Key Biscayne today to do some promo for GTA 6 🔥 https://t.co/hhRg2OP8i6
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar和West Coast Customs今天现身比斯坎湾岛，为《GTA6》做宣传🔥 https://t.co/hhRg2OP8i6

paragraphs.en: Got pictures and several videos of the GTA 6 cars driving around Miami!
paragraphs.cn: 拍到了《GTA6》主题车辆在迈阿密行驶的照片，还有好几段视频！

paragraphs.en: Some fans speculate that Rockstar is shooting a live-action GTA 6 trailer and will utilize some of the real ads around the city to highlight the fact it has created a real-life version of Vice City. As of right now, Rockstar hasn't addressed any of this advertising, and has instead let it speak for itself. Similarly, there have been reports that Rockstar will be releasing real-life versions of GTA beer brands in the near future following listings on a government database.
paragraphs.cn: 一些粉丝猜测，Rockstar正在拍摄《GTA6》真人预告片，并会利用城中实际投放的部分广告，突出其打造了现实版罪恶都市这一点。截至目前，Rockstar尚未对这些广告宣传作出任何说明，而是让广告自己说话。类似地，此前有政府数据库收录了相关条目，随后有报道称，Rockstar将在不久后推出《GTA》中虚构啤酒品牌的现实产品。

paragraphs.en: It's anyone's guess what all of this is being used for, but all signs seem to point to it being related to GTA. Rockstar has already announced that its Miami Heat sponsored game will be called "A Night in Vice City," so maybe there are plans for more activities around the entire city beyond the actual basketball game. Either way, this is some next-level marketing and shows Rockstar is sparing no expense.
paragraphs.cn: 这一切究竟有何用途，谁也说不准，但种种迹象似乎都表明它与《GTA》有关。Rockstar已经宣布，其赞助的迈阿密热火队比赛将以「罪恶都市之夜」为主题，因此，除了篮球比赛本身，或许还计划在全城举办更多活动。无论如何，这场营销确实更上一层楼，也表明Rockstar不惜重金。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
